dedupe_keys.name: ager sao tome and principe telecommunications statistical indicators market observatory 2016 to 2023

description: AGER, the general regulatory authority of São Tomé and Príncipe, publishes a market observatory of telecommunications statistics. The page lists four reports: indicators for 2016, statistics for 2017 and 2018, and the 2023 market observatory of 29 pages. The 2023 report gives an overview of the market, fixed voice subscribers and penetration, fixed and mobile traffic, mobile subscribers, internet and broadband subscribers, and operator shares, with tables and charts. The operators are CST (Companhia Santomense de Telecomunicações) and Unitel STP. Coverage: São Tomé and Príncipe, national totals by year. Format and access: PDF reports on the AGER website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: gaps between 2018 and 2023; PDF only; small market, so operator figures may be withheld. Simulation uses: demand baselines for a small island telecom system that depends on one submarine cable, for resilience studies of cable cuts. Related records: data-telegeography-submarine-cable-map shows the ACE cable landing; data-itu-ict-statistics gives national series.
